label: late-position w in long sequences (weak)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase of long sequences (L=8-9), at steps 6-8, mostly on the last or second-to-last original token; never in the copy phase and never before step 4. A small share of mass (~6%) is on the <DEL> step. The input token w carries 65% of the activation mass (17x lift), and the strongest activations are a w at position 7-8 right before <DEL>. Firing is sparse and context-dependent: most late ws do not activate it (precision ~0.24 on dev), and active sequences are over-represented for first token i and k at position 1-2, but adding those conditions trades recall for precision without raising F1. Non-w activations are weak and spread over many tokens at the last original positions. Dev F1 is about 0.30 with mass recall 0.52, so this is only a partial description.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=i (+5.66), orig2=k (+5.28), phase=0 & in_tok=w (+4.10), orig3=k (+3.86), orig1=k (+3.53), in_tok=w (+3.27). Lower it: phase=2 (-6.86), next_out=- (-3.81), orig1=f (-3.64), t=4 (-3.61).
